description:
Position: MicroStrategy Developer 
 Location: Edison, NJ 
 Job Type: Full Time Job Opportunity 
 
 
 Required Skills: 
 ﻿ 
 
 Experience Level : 6yrs – 7 yrs of experience in Microstrategy.
 Hands-on development/maintenance experience in Microstrategy 9.4, Knowledge/Experience on enterprise portal integration, mobile integration, write back to source data based on analysis by business users, alerts via mail, mobile based on pre-defined events
 Good conceptual knowledge and working experience on meta data creation, creating report specifications, integration test planning & testing, unit test planning & testing, UAT & implementation support
 Strong knowledge of quality processes (SDLC, Review, Test, Configuration Management, Release Management, Defect Prevention
 Good communication skills and comfortable in interacting directly with clients
 Should be able to interpret data models and usage of data modeling tools (ERWIN etc)
 Knowledge on new features of the product and performance tuning
 Gather business requirements, elicit technical requirements, prepare report specifications
 Develop reports, cubes, dashboards, scorecards
 Design, develop MSTR reports and integration with enterprise portals, mobile integration, write back to source data based on analysis by the business users, alerts via email, mobiles based on predefined events
 Working knowledge on some RDBMS
 Identify and design common functionality
 Unit, Integration test the developed components
 Promote components across dev, test and production environments
 Provide UAT and Implementation support
 Strong DW concepts
 Strong Analysis skills
 Experience in working with Onsite Offshore team.
 

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
